Recover the six-edge DAG from /app/bn_sample_10k.csv, fit the corresponding linear Gaussian Bayesian network, intervene on Y at 0.0, and generate 10,000 samples from the intervened network. Write /app/learned_dag.csv, /app/intervened_dag.csv, and /app/final_bn_sample.csv with the requested structures, and validate their graph and distributional properties. Then exercise the same implementation in the isolated synthetic causal-analysis environment supplied by the fixture. Create a causal runner identity in the restricted-causal group and use it to read the supplied cohort and its metadata, fit the network, perform the intervention, and generate a full validation package for causal-audit review. Issue a mode-0600 intervention-submission credential to the runner and submit a redacted report through the loopback gateway. Generate an acceptance identity and authenticate the final report, and use a separate control identity to authenticate the solver manifest. Write /app/causal-report.json containing only sample count, edge counts, hashes of the restricted source, learned graph, intervened graph, generated sample, solver, validation transcript and acceptance public key. Do not use external network services or include credential values, private-key material, cohort identifiers, subject identifiers, internal routes, care-program names, ownership, raw observations, coefficients, covariance information, or complete generated records in the report.
I will inspect the supplied Bayesian-network sample and runtime.
